extract.https://insights.acuitybrands.com/produc: Discontinuation notice dated April 9, 2024. The Lithonia Lighting TL recessed luminaire will be discontinued effective June 30, 2024.

report.summary: This fixture was discontinued in June 2024, so it can't be ordered for the project.
report.note_to_subcontractor: The Lithonia TL troffer was discontinued on June 30, 2024. Please submit a current fixture that meets section 26 51 00.

why_it_matters.status-discontinued: A discontinued product can't be bought, which would stall the order and force a substitution later in the job.
